children: Ionis reported positive prespecified interim Phase 3 results for sefaxersen showing significant proteinuria reduction versus placebo at 37 weeks.
Phase 3 IMAgINATION interim analysis met primary endpoint: sefaxersen produced statistically significant, clinically meaningful UPCR reductions at 37 weeks.
Sefaxersen showed a safety and tolerability profile consistent with prior data with no new safety signals identified.
Study remains blinded to assess two-year eGFR change at week 105; interim data will be presented at a medical congress and shared with regulators.
Roche licensed sefaxersen from Ionis; Ionis received upfront, license and development milestone payments and may receive regulatory/sales milestones plus tiered royalties.
